jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong.  Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Position Overview
The Operations Manager leads and oversees the China Operations team, ensuring high-quality, compliant, and efficient delivery of data center and server room services in alignment with client standards, SLAs, and business objectives. This role directly manages the Operations Engineer(s) and serves as the primary point of accountability for operational performance, resource planning, vendor coordination, and client satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead and manage the server room operations with consistent execution, including monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and incident resolution for IT infrastructure (servers, network equipment, power, cooling, etc.).
- Oversee capacity planning for server rooms—tracking and forecasting power, cooling, rack space, loading, and network port utilization to support current and future needs. Collaborate with IT and facilities teams to optimize layout and resource allocation.
- Review, validate and approve all change requests, permits, and documentation related to IT hardware work including installation, decommissioning, migrations, refreshes, and any other works that may have potential impact.
- Manage relationships with vendors and third-party service providers; approve work schedules, supervise on-site activities, and ensure deliverables meet client standards and contractual obligations.
- Maintain strict compliance with physical security protocols and environmental controls (temperature, humidity, power redundancy) in all server room facilities.
- Ensure accurate and up-to-date inventory records of hardware, software, and network components using designated tools (e.g., Patch Manager).
- Drive the development, review, and continuous improvement of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all server room activities.
- Enforce adherence to client policies, industry best practices (e.g., ISO, TIA-942), and regulatory requirements governing data center operations.
- Lead participation in disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution to ensure client business continuity.
- Collaborate closely with regional IT, facilities, and client teams to align operations with broader technical and strategic goals.
- Stay current with emerging data center technologies, trends, and operational efficiencies to enhance service delivery.

Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in data center or server room operations, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or team lead capacity.
- Demonstrated expertise in data center infrastructure, including power, cooling, cabling standards, and hardware lifecycle management.
- In-depth knowledge of cabling standard and cable management in data center.
- Knowledge in using all standard cable testers used in data centers (e.g., Fluke Networks, VIAVI , or comparable tools) to verify and certify copper and fiber cabling integrity.
- Strong knowledge of building services engineering and facility management principles.
- Strong troubleshooting and incident handling skills and ability to follow technical procedures accurately.
- Experience with ServiceNow or similar ticketing systems is highly desirable.
- Proven ability to manage vendors, incidents, and cross-functional projects under tight deadlines.
- Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- Professional certifications such as CDCP, CDCS, CCNA, MCSE, or PMP are highly desirable.
- Ability to work collaboratively across local and regional teams and with external vendors.

Additional Information
This role reports to the APAC Operations Leadership and may require occasional travel within China or regionally. The Operations Manager is accountable for team performance, client satisfaction, and operational excellence across all managed sites in China

On-site –Beijing, CHN

- Additional ad hoc data requests are periodically fielded from the client, typically with a quick turnaround requested

- Sourcing planning including renewals and renegotiations, cost savings opportunities, RFQs, etc

o   JLL Sourcing and Procurement / Category management initiatives ie: Supplier Performance Management efforts, Alliance Partners, Cleaning Essentials and/or regional equivalents where applicable
o   Maintaining awareness of S&P systems, updates, processes, policies, trainings, implementations, etc and applying them to the Solventum portfolio
Ensuring connectivity of integrations between JLL S&P systems and troubleshooting any technical issues

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager
jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong.  Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

关于仲量联行（JLL）
我们是仲量联行（JLL），一家专注于房地产领域的专业服务与投资管理公司。作为《财富》世界500强企业，我们助力房地产所有者、使用者和投资者实现其商业目标。如果你希望提升职业生涯，JLL是你理想的职业平台。在这里，你将有机会与全球领先企业共同创新，将专业知识应用于标志性项目，并参与推动房地产行业变革的倡议。你还将建立持久的专业人脉，并从行业佼佼者身上获得启发。我们关注机遇，也致力于帮助你最大化自身潜力。加入JLL，实现你的职业抱负！
关于仲量科技（JLL Technologies）
JLL科技（JLL/T）是JLL旗下的业务部门，将成为推动JLL未来增长的核心力量，因为科技为行业带来了巨大机遇和颠覆性变革。JLL/T的使命是将科技创新引入商业地产领域。我们在业内独树一帜，为全球客户提供无与伦比的数字化咨询、实施及服务解决方案。我们的目标是通过技术手段提升全球楼宇的价值与流动性，同时提高楼宇使用者的生产力与幸福感。
关于该职位
我们正在寻找一位能力出众、积极主动的销售经理加入JLLT团队，推动业务增长。你将与全球顶尖的商业地产（CRE）企业合作，为其打造全面的CRE数据解决方案。成功的关键在于你能否建立长期、以服务为导向的客户关系。你将通过建议产品使用频率、覆盖范围和品牌效果，并利用我们专有的分析工具和报告能力，清晰展示投资回报率。日常工作中，你将依托JLLT在商业地产行业的深厚知识与专业经验，通过客户开发、研究行业趋势与新闻、开展高效的产品演示等方式，不断拓展客户组合。
岗位职责包括：
- 全面了解客户及其需求

- 成为JLLT关键信息与营销解决方案的专家

- 全权负责完整的销售周期，包括：客户开发、产品演示、成交、客户上线、培训及续约

- 高频次开展面对面的客户及潜在客户产品演示

- 为商业地产市场的所有参与者（包括经纪人、业主、投资者、贷款方、租户等）提供有价值的洞察

- 代表JLLT主办并参加行业活动，在本地市场与商业地产专业人士建立联系

应聘要求：
- 必须拥有学士学位

- 具备金融行业及商业地产行业的客户对接经验者优先

- 拥有五年以上B2B环境下的成功外勤销售经验，销售内容为数据、研究或分析平台/工具

- 在顾问式销售环境中，有持续超额完成销售指标和配额的实绩

- 拥有两年以上在销售完成后为客户进行解决方案使用培训的经验

- 具备丰富的租赁管理经验者优先

你可从我们这里获得：
我们拥有创业精神浓厚、包容性强的企业文化。无论是在办公桌旁还是在全球范围内，我们都携手共进。我们相信优秀的人才能激发彼此的卓越，因此我们大力投入于相互支持、共同学习和庆祝成功。我们的“全面薪酬”计划体现了我们在职业发展、认可激励、身心健康、福利待遇和薪酬方面的承诺。我们将为你提供具有竞争力的薪资与福利待遇。
在JLL，你将不断发挥自身优势，体验丰富多样的职业历程。我们迫不及待想看到你在JLL实现怎样的职业抱负！
立即申请！

About JLL
We're JLL. We're a professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. As a fortune 500 company, we help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions.

If you're looking to step up your career, JLL is the perfect professional home. With us, you'll have a chance to innovate with the world's leading businesses, put that expertise into action on landmark projects, and work on game-changing real estate initiatives. You'll also make long-lasting professional connections and be inspired by the best. We're focused on opportunity and want to help you make the most of yours. Achieve your ambitions, join us at JLL!

About JLL Technologies
JLL Technologies (JLL/T) is a division of JLL and will be the driver of much of JLL’s future growth given the opportunities and disruption technologies bring to the business. At JLL/T, the mission is to bring technology innovation to commercial real estate. Unique to the industry, JLL/T delivers unparalleled digital advisory, implementation and services solutions to organization globally. Its goal is to leverage technology to increase the value and liquidity of the world's buildings, while enhancing the productivity and the happiness of those that occupy them.
About   the   role
We’re looking for an highly skilled and motivated Sales Manager to join JLLT to drive business growth.
You will partner with the world’s top CRE players to develop a comprehensive CRE data solution for their business. Key to your success will be your ability to build long lasting, service focused, customer relationships. You will achieve this in part by advising on product frequency, reach and brand efficacy and highlighting return on investment using our proprietary analytic tools and reporting capabilities. Day to day, you will leverage JLLT’s deep knowledge and expertise in the Commercial Real Estate industry to build your client portfolio by prospecting, studying industry trends and news, and conducting effective product demonstrations.

What   this   job   involves:
·       Gain a thorough understanding of your clients and their needs
·       Become an expert in JLLT’s critical information and marketing solutions
·       Complete ownership of the full sales cycle including: prospecting, demoing, closing, onboarding, training and renewing
·       Conduct a high level of in person client and prospect product demonstrations
·       Provide valuable insight to all participants in the commercial property market, including Brokers, Owners, Investors, Lenders, Tenants etc.
·       Represent JLLT by hosting and attending industry events and networking with commercial real estate professionals in your market

Sound   like   you? To   apply you   will   have:

·       Bachelor’s degree required
·       Client facing experience in the Financial Industry and Commercial Real Estate industry strongly preferred
·       Five or more years of successful outside sales experience in a B2B environment selling Data, Research and Analytic platforms or tools.
·       Proven track record exceeding sales targets and quotas in a consultative sales environment
·       Two or more years of experience training clients on how to use a solution post sales.
·       Extensive experience in leasing management is preferred.

What you   can expect   from us
We're an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. We succeed together-across the desk and around the globe. We believe the best inspires the best, so we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our success.
Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, well-being, benefits and pay. We'll offer you a competitive salary and benefits package.
With us, you'll develop your strengths and enjoy a career full of varied experiences. We can't wait to see where your ambitions take you at JLL.

Apply today!

jobs.title: Head of Sales – International Residential Development Sales – Shanghai
jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong.  Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

We are seeking an experienced Head of Sales for a strategic leadership role based in Shanghai. This position plays a pivotal role in supporting our International Residential (IR) platform and driving the successful marketing and sales of international residential developments across key markets, including Japan, Australia, the United Kingdom, the UAE, Saudi Arabia (KSA), and Portugal.
Leveraging JLL’s established global residential network, market-leading portfolio, and strategic client relationships, the successful candidate will lead the sales, marketing, and promotion of international residential projects in Shanghai. The role requires close collaboration with sales teams across the APAC region and key international stakeholders to maximize business opportunities and achieve revenue growth.
The successful candidate will be responsible for leading a team of two direct reports and will work closely with the IR China Marketing Lead within a matrix reporting structure, ensuring strong alignment between sales and marketing strategies to deliver business objectives.

Key Responsibilities
- Drive sales performance and revenue growth for the International Residential business in Shanghai.
- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing sales team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and excellence.
- Promote and sell international residential developments to prospective investors and buyers.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with developers, investors, and key stakeholders across international markets.
- Collaborate with regional and global teams to develop and execute effective sales and marketing strategies.
- Work closely with the IR China Marketing Lead and APAC sales teams to ensure alignment of business development, marketing, and sales initiatives.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer demand to identify new business opportunities and support strategic decision-making.
- Consistently deliver against individual and team sales targets, KPIs, and revenue goals.

Key Requirements
The ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications and attributes:
- A recognized market specialist with extensive international sales expertise and a comprehensive understanding of global residential property markets.
- A highly results-oriented and self-motivated professional with proven ability to lead, motivate, and inspire sales teams while maintaining strong attention to detail and delivering outstanding personal sales performance.
- Demonstrated success in achieving individual sales targets while leading teams to meet and exceed revenue and business objectives.
- Proven ability to operate effectively across multiple time zones and manage international stakeholder relationships while consistently delivering against challenging KPIs and revenue targets.
- Strong proficiency in written and spoken English.
- A minimum of 10 years’ relevant experience in residential property sales, international residential sales, or related real estate sectors.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and client relationship-building skills.

国际住宅地产销售总监 - 上海

我们正在寻求一位经验丰富的销售总监加入上海团队，担任这一关键战略领导岗位。该职位将在支持JLL国际住宅（International Residential, IR）业务平台发展方面发挥重要作用，并负责推动来自日本、澳大利亚、英国、阿联酋、沙特阿拉伯及葡萄牙等重点市场的国际住宅项目在中国市场的推广与销售。
依托仲量联行成熟的全球住宅业务网络、市场领先的项目组合以及深厚的客户关系资源，成功候选人将负责领导上海地区国际住宅项目的销售、市场推广及品牌宣传工作。该职位需要与亚太区销售团队及国际业务相关利益相关方保持紧密协作，以最大化业务机会并推动收入增长。
成功候选人将负责管理两名直属下属，并在矩阵式汇报架构下与中国区国际住宅市场营销负责人紧密合作，确保销售与市场策略高度协同，从而支持并实现业务目标。

主要职责
- 推动上海国际住宅业务的销售业绩提升及收入增长。
- 领导、辅导并发展高绩效销售团队，营造协作、担当和追求卓越的团队文化。
- 向潜在投资者及购房客户推广并销售国际住宅开发项目。
- 与国际市场的开发商、投资者及关键利益相关方建立并维护稳固的合作关系。
- 与区域及全球团队协作，制定并执行有效的销售及市场推广策略。
- 与中国区国际住宅市场营销负责人及亚太区销售团队密切合作，确保业务拓展、市场营销及销售计划保持一致。
- 持续监测市场趋势、竞争对手动态以及客户需求变化，发掘新的业务机会，并为战略决策提供支持。
- 持续达成并超越个人及团队销售目标、关键绩效指标（KPIs）及收入目标。

任职要求
理想候选人应具备以下资格与能力：
- 具备丰富国际销售经验的资深市场专家，对全球住宅房地产市场拥有全面且深入的理解。
- 结果导向、自我驱动，具备优秀的销售领导能力，能够有效带领、激励并赋能销售团队，同时保持高度细致的工作作风，并取得卓越的个人销售业绩。
- 拥有成功达成个人销售目标，并带领团队实现及超越收入和业务目标的良好记录。
- 具备跨时区高效开展工作的能力，能够管理国际利益相关方关系，并持续达成具挑战性的关键绩效指标及收入目标。
- 具备优秀的中英文书面及口头沟通能力，英语能力尤佳。
- 拥有不少于10年房地产住宅销售、国际住宅销售或相关房地产领域的工作经验。
- 具备出色的沟通、谈判、利益相关方管理及客户关系建设能力。

On-site –Shanghai, China

jobs.title: Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong.  Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Key Accountabilities
Reporting directly to Senior Director – Operations, Commercial and Compliance, this role operates on-site at the client's semiconductor manufacturing facility in Chengdu China and serves as the critical bridge between vendor management, competitive pricing, SOW compliance, and ethical procurement practices.

The role encompasses leading and managing all Procurement Activities related to services and materials for Integrated Facilities Management (IFM), ensuring cost efficiency, service quality, supply risk mitigation, and compliance with company policies and applicable regulations. Full accountability spans the complete vendor lifecycle—from selection and contract negotiation through service delivery quality assurance and payment reconciliation between client, JLL, and vendors.
Success in this role requires deep understanding of building technical systems, cross-functional coordination, and direct client engagement.
This role requires:
- High-pressure tolerance and resilience in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
- Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
- Sharp judgment and situational awareness to navigate complex vendor, client, and internal dynamics
- Familiarity with procurement platforms, JDE systems, or workflow management tools
- Ability to balance competing priorities: cost competitiveness, service quality, compliance, and client satisfaction

Key Responsibilities
IFM Procurement Management
- Manage procurement processes for services and materials related to building technical systems including HVAC (Heating, Ventilation & Air Conditioning), Electrical & UPS Systems, Process Utilities, I&C (Instrumentation & Control), Fire & Life Safety Systems (LSS), and other MEP systems
- Evaluate, select, and manage technical service vendors/contractors, ensuring competitive quality and pricing
- Negotiate contracts, terms, and conditions with suppliers/vendors/contractors
- Monitor and evaluate supplier performance, ensuring SLA compliance

Cross-Functional Coordination & Client Management
- Work closely with Operations, Engineering, Finance, EHS and other relevant teams within JLL
- Engage directly with client to understand requirements and advise on optimal procurement solutions
- Build long-term relationships with client and stakeholders
- Participate in regular client meetings, report progress, and results

Cost Control & Optimization
- Develop and implement procurement strategies to optimize costs
- Analyze spending, identify savings opportunities, and improve processes

Financial & Commercial Management
- Prepare service quotations (CBS/SSJ) from to client, ensuring competitive pricing, accurate costing, and profitability targets
- Oversee and validate payment reconciliation processes between client, JLL, and vendors executed by the team
- Ensure the team maintains proper invoice processing, documentation standards, and audit readiness

Requirements
Experience & Knowledge
- Minimum 3-5 years of procurement experience, preferably with IFM/FM service management background
- Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, high-tech facilities, or similar regulated environments (preferred)
- Strong understanding of building technical systems: HVAC, Electrical, LSS, MEP, and related maintenance/operations services
- Familiarity with cleanroom operations, process utilities, or critical facility systems (advantage)
- Experience managing technical service contractors/vendors
- Knowledge of contracts, negotiation, and risk management in procurement
- Proven track record in process improvement, operational excellence, cost optimization, and KPI management.
- Experience supporting audits, internal controls, trade compliance, and regulatory requirements.

Core Competencies
- High attention to detail: Meticulous in supplier evaluation, contract review, and quality control
- Market awareness: Stay updated on pricing trends, new technologies, and procurement optimization opportunities
- Excellent communication skills: Confident in engaging with clients, suppliers, and stakeholders at all levels
- Analytical thinking: Process data, analyze costs, and make data-driven decisions
- Negotiation skills: Effectively negotiate to achieve the best outcomes for the company and client

Soft Skills
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively
- Effective time management and prioritization
- Flexible and adaptable in dynamic work environments
- High sense of ownership and proactive approach

Education & Certifications
- Bachelor's degree or higher in Business Administration, Engineering, or related field
- Fluent in English (spoken and written)

Personal Attributes
The ideal candidate is meticulous and detail-oriented in their work, while also being sharp and market-aware with a keen eye for business opportunities. They should excel at building trusted relationships with internal teams, cross-functional partners within JLL, and client. This person combines strategic vision in procurement with strong attention to execution details.

Location:

On-site –Chengdu, SC
